messages:
maya: Quick sync — small ask: we want a low-key ‘phonebooth’ micro-ceremony for spot-award recipients next week. thinking 5–7 minute handoffs, sticker + handwritten note kit. who can own logistics?
cal: I can own kit pickup and onsite setup on Tues/Wed. will need a volunteer for the shipping list + remote kits.
joan: happy to own remote kit shipping and tracking. need the final recipient list + addresses by EOD Fri.
maya: thanks! i'll compile list today. joan — are we doing pre-filled boxes or assembly on-demand?
joan: pre-filled. keeps it consistent and reduces mistakes. plan: pack, label, scan tracking, email recipients. budget ok for small couriers?
mike: budget approved up to $300 for outbound small-batch same-week. choose USPS priority or local courier for APAC folks?
cal: APAC — use local courier recommended in team sheet (see last column). US/EU -> USPS/UPS. joan can you post the courier matrix once you have the addresses?
joan: will do. i'll also add a 'do not ship' toggle for those who opt for desk pickup.
maya: perfect. volunteer hosts: @cal will host HQ dropoffs, @joan hosts remote kit ops. @mike will handle photo ops and short intro script.
cal: short script idea: 1) congrats + reason for award, 2) hand over sticker/note, 3) quick team cheer. keep it under 2 minutes.
mike: adding: take a 5s clip for the team channel, then drop the pic in #all-hands-spotlights. will get consent template.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: tax/spot-award payroll cutoff is in 6 business days. Ensure amounts submitted to payroll by Tues 9am PT.
maya: good call — payroll deadline noted. joan, can you tag records for payroll export?
joan: yes. i'll add a `spot_award:pending` tag column and export CSV by Mon night.
mike: do we need a simple RSVP so recipients can opt for in-person vs remote?
joan: added a column in the sheet for "pickup preference". maya pls add the link.
maya: sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBz-Phonebooth-Kits (fill column G: pickup preference)
cal: shipping checklist snippet for packers:
```
- verify name + address
- include handwritten note
- sticker + pin + sticker insert
- packing slip inside
- affix shipping label
- scan tracking to sheet
```
joan: packing window: Mon morning pack, Mon afternoon label + scan, Tues courier pickup. remote exceptions: international packs Tues-Wed.
maya: volunteers: cal for HQ host, joan for remote shipping, mike for photos/consent, me for recipient messaging. anyone else?
cal: i'll bring extra envelopes and tape. can someone grab Sharpies?
maya: i'll swing by office supplies.
joan: sending the final addresses by 5pm Fri. will also post the courier matrix and the final pack list in this thread.
mike: small ask — can we keep these quiet? no big fanfare, just micro-ceremony vibes. :smile:
maya: agreed. informal + sincere. thanks team — will post final checklist once joan confirms pack counts.
